name: Orlando

zoning_layer.note: Orlando Zoning, published by the City of Orlando open data account (OpenData_Orlando) on ArcGIS Online. 325 distinct values. The field holds the base district plus overlay suffixes, for example R-2A/T/HP. The match column lists every stored value for each base district. Also has PD_NAME and OverlayA-D text fields. Values not covered: PD, C, P, H, UR, I-C, I-G, I-P, AC-3A, ASD-2, UNINCORPORATED, NO CITY ZONING, SUBJECT TO ORANGE COUNTY. Spatial reference 2236 (Florida East, feet); ask for outSR=4326.

overlay_layers.note: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer, special flood hazard areas, hosted by Esri. 3,792 polygons for Orange County; tested 2026-11-17. FEMA's own server (hazards.fema.gov NFHL MapServer/28) reset the connection from this network. A full copy with zone X sits in the city's ArcGIS org at https://services5.arcgis.com/mMuoPCaIYD4wEgDl/arcgis/rest/services/Flood_Hazard_Zone_Parcels/FeatureServer/0 (5,086 polygons, zones A, AE, AH, X, D), published by a staff account, not the open data account.
30 special plan areas under LDC Ch. 62; field LDC gives the section
Growth Management Plan future land use; a rezoning must fit it

permit_source.note: Permit Applications. 1,115,820 rows on 2026-11-17, newest processed_date 2026-11-17. Worked without a key. Fields include permit_number, application_type, worktype, parcel_number (15 digits), permit_address, estimated_cost, square_footage, processed_date, issue_permit_date, final_date, coo_date, application_status, neighborhood. Filter application_type = 'Building Permit' and worktype = 'New' (44,131 rows). No unit-count field.

disclaimer: Estimates, not tax, legal, zoning or appraisal advice.
